evals.prompt: Review a CI/CD pipeline that builds, tests, scans and deploys a service to production.
evals.expected_output: A staged gate policy with evidence, blocking behavior, ownership, artifact integrity and deployment verification.
expectations: Places fast feedback before expensive checks
Addresses secrets, provenance and least privilege

evals.prompt: Design a safe recovery plan after a failed deployment caused by a configuration change.
evals.expected_output: A controlled rollback/canary plan with stop conditions, notifications, evidence and follow-up.
expectations: Does not assume rollback is always safe
